bottleneck.description: Machine vision systems (~11-21% share) sharing the global machine vision market with Keyence, Basler, Teledyne, Omron and SICK in a 5-player 20-30% fragmented oligopoly.

dependency.key_customers: Amazon (logistics), automotive OEMs, EV battery manufacturers, consumer electronics assemblers, semiconductor packaging
dependency.key_suppliers: Sony (CMOS image sensors), FPGA/ASIC vendors, optical lens manufacturers

editorial.notes: Cognex is a top-2 global machine vision player alongside Keyence, with deep learning (VisionPro/In-Sight) and developer ecosystem providing stickiness. However the market is contested by Keyence, Basler, Teledyne DALSA, Omron, SICK and MVTec; logistics and automotive customers (52% of revenue) routinely run multi-vendor vision stacks. Software moat creates switching friction but realistic substitution paths exist at the application level; rating aligns with LOW anchor for contested industrial automation incumbents.
